mapper.update: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS consult_opening ( account_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL COMMENT '账号', text_hash CHAR(64) NOT NULL COMMENT '原话摘要', consultation_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL COMMENT '这一轮咨询', created_at DATETIME(3) NOT NULL COMMENT '占住时间', PRIMARY KEY (account_id, text_hash) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='8秒内同一句只开一轮'
